narrative_sections.title: Remote / WFH intelligence — work from Bangalore for any India employer
narrative_sections.raw_html:
Remote / WFH intelligence — work from Bangalore for any India employer

Based on active 2025-2026 job postings. The Pega market is one of the most remote-friendly niches in Indian IT.

Remote-first reality

70%+ of Pega job postings in India are tagged Remote, PAN India, or Hybrid (3 days). Many GCCs (Lloyds, NatWest, BofA, Barclays) offer hybrid with preferred hubs in Bangalore/Chennai/Hyderabad. Several postings explicitly say "Anywhere in India" — perfect for Bangalore base.

CTC bands observed (2025-2026)

CSSA 5-8 yrs: 20-30 LPA • CSSA 8-12 yrs: 25-37 LPA • LSA/CLSA 10+ yrs: 30-50+ LPA • Remote roles sometimes pay 10-15% less than onsite but offer full location flexibility.

Strategy for Bangalore-based remote targeting

1. Apply to all GCC roles in Chennai/Hyderabad/Pune/Gurgaon that list "hybrid" — many allow remote 2-3 days with monthly visits. 2. Target Pegasystems India directly (Remote India CLSA role live). 3. SI firms (EY, Deloitte, Virtusa, Cognizant) routinely offer PAN India remote Pega positions. 4. Contract-to-hire remote roles on LinkedIn pay 25-35 LPA for CSSA with 5+ years. 5. Companies like Booking Holdings, PayPal, Visa already have Bangalore offices — hybrid is easiest.

narrative_sections.raw_html:
Detailed team dossiers — mission, stack, daily work and people

Roster labels are strict: Exact means the public profile explicitly names the team/product; Likely means current employer and role align but assignment is not named; Adjacent means a connected leader, user or alumnus; Recruiter is a public TA route.

1 · Evernorth — DPA COE / Office for Intelligent Automation

Mission: Build and govern reusable enterprise automation across Pega BPM, Pega RPA/RDA and UiPath. Operate shared layers, deployment tooling, license/cost controls and AI knowledge platforms.

Products: Pega Common Layer, FLAC license forecasting, enterprise RAG platform, Deployment Manager integration, digital assistants and reusable healthcare automation.

Daily work: Case and integration design, Common Layer merges/skims, Python/GitHub deployment automation, Jenkins pipelines, RAG features, platform upgrades, architecture reviews, observability and production support.

Stack: Pega, Deployment Manager, Robotics, UiPath, Python, FastAPI, React, PostgreSQL, LangChain, Azure AI Search/OpenAI, Bedrock, GitHub, Jenkins, Splunk and Dynatrace.

Scale: Public evidence of a 22-engineer OIA factory and a separate 10+ person AI-assistant effort.

Why exciting: Best public bridge from traditional CSSA work into full-stack, RAG, AI-assisted engineering and platform automation.

2 · Pegasystems India — CDH / AI Product Engineering

Mission: Build the Customer Decision Hub product—the always-on AI brain that selects next-best actions across billions of customer interactions.

Components: NBA Designer, adaptive models, decisioning runtime, CDH Blueprint, Data/Business Change pipelines, Action Analysis, 1:1 Operations Manager, Value Finder, Ethical Bias and agentic AI/MCP.

Daily work: Java/Pega product development, distributed-system design, REST APIs, decisioning performance, migration/release pipelines, adaptive ML, code/design reviews and difficult customer incident analysis.

Stack: Java, Pega CDH, Python, Kafka, Cassandra, PostgreSQL, Kubernetes, AWS, Docker/Helm, REST, ML, GenAI, MCP and prompt engineering.

Scale: Billions of interactions daily, thousands of requests per second and very large customer datasets.

Why exciting: Deepest product/AI engineering; strongest technical growth, but also the highest coding and distributed-systems bar.

Mission: Run and evolve global Pega platforms for payment investigations, exceptions, recalls, amendments, SWIFT inquiries and sanctions-alert disposition.

Products: Payment Investigations, Smart Investigate expertise, Global Sanctions Manager, screening-engine and SWIFT integrations.

Daily work: Build case types/routing/SLAs, integrate SWIFT and screening, implement maker-checker controls, tune production, support upgrades/cloud, work with compliance and payment operations.

Stack: Pega, Smart Investigate, SWIFT, sanctions AI/ML, Oracle/SQL, XML, APIs, Cloud/GAIA, Tracer/PAL/DB Trace.

Scale: Around 9M sanctions alerts/year and 99% STP for false positives.

Why exciting: Best regulated-payments bridge from Kafka/recovery experience into high-scale AI case orchestration.

Mission: Modernize Ford Credit operations across collections, receivables, treasury/security and customer/account servicing using Pega DPA, robotics, decisioning and AI.

Daily work: Discover automation opportunities, quantify FTE impact, design Pega/robotic solutions, integrate ERP/APIs/OCR, operate CI/CD, Robot Manager, PDC, access, DR and SaaS migration.

Stack: Pega Infinity, DPA, CDH, Robotics, Java, C#/Python, REST, GCP, Vertex/Document AI, SAP/Ariba, Alteryx, Qlik, New Relic/Kibana/PDC.

Scale: Public profiles cite 40+ workflows/59 FTE saved; broader Ford RPA estate is larger but overlaps teams.

Why exciting: Easiest automotive move into AI/cloud/platform engineering while preserving finance-domain depth.

narrative_sections.title: Referral dossiers — 5–6 verified public contacts per priority company
narrative_sections.raw_html:
Referral dossiers — 5–6 verified public contacts per priority company

Each dossier contains a functional contact chain, not a claimed reporting chain. “Direct” means the public profile lists the target company. Recheck every profile immediately before outreach.

How to use these dossiers

First message

Choose one current engineer whose experience resembles yours. Ask about the team and requisition route—not for an immediate referral.

Second message

Approach the architect or platform lead with a focused question about Kafka, Constellation, CDH, collections or production ownership.

Third message

Contact TA only with a live job ID, or ask whether they can route you to the recruiter who owns Pega hiring.

narrative_sections.title: Outreach system
narrative_sections.raw_html:
Outreach system

Do not message everyone at once. Use the employee who resembles your role first, then the architect/platform lead, then TA after locating a requisition.

Referral peer

Hi [Name], I’m a Pega CSSA with four years at MBRDI across Kafka, REST/SQL, auto-finance collections and L2/L3 production ownership. Your Pega work at [Company] looks closely aligned, and I’d value connecting and learning about the team.

Platform leader

Hi [Name], I’m a Pega CSSA at MBRDI with four years in Kafka integrations, collections and production automation. Your work leading [platform/team] matches the direction I’m pursuing. I’d value connecting and learning what capabilities your team prioritizes.

Recruiter with role ID

Hi [Name], I’ve applied for [title, requisition]. I’m a Pega CSSA with four years at MBRDI across Kafka, REST/SOAP, SQL, auto-finance collections and production automation. Could you advise whether my profile aligns with the approved level?

Follow-up

Thanks for connecting. I own Pega/Kafka modernization across seven APAC markets and built AI-assisted tooling that reduced mapping effort from four weeks to ten minutes. If your team has a suitable 4–6-year opening, would you be comfortable sharing the requisition or referral route?

Run applications, referrals, interview preparation and AI upskilling concurrently.

Days 1–14 · Activate market

  • Apply to top direct targets immediately.
  • Send ten targeted requests per week.
  • Prepare six impact stories.

Days 15–45 · Strengthen profile

  • Python, FastAPI and testing.
  • Constellation and modern Pega.

  • Build sanitized migration analyzer.

Days 46–90 · Close offers

  • Maintain concurrent interview loops.
  • Negotiate fixed before variable.
  • Verify legal employer and ownership.
  • Choose before TCS joining where possible.

narrative_sections.title: Evidence and maintenance rules
narrative_sections.raw_html:
Evidence and maintenance rules

This is a living research snapshot, not a mathematically complete customer registry. Pega does not publicly disclose every customer, and many customer stories are anonymized.

Classification logic

  • Confirmed direct: named Pega use plus local direct team/hiring evidence.
  • Probable: strong signal, but one local ownership detail remains unresolved.
  • Global-only: company uses Pega, but India Pega ownership is unproven.
  • Rejected: certification, former employment, partner delivery or generic automation only.

Before acting

  • Recheck the current job and profile date.
  • Confirm legal employer and permanent/C2H status.
  • Ask which Pega product and version.
  • Confirm India owns architecture and roadmap.
